replacements.after:
def record_submission_event(
        self,
        manuscript_id: str,
        *,
        venue: str,
        round_number: int,
        status: str,
        detail: str | None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        payload = SubmissionEventInput(
            venue=venue, round=round_number, status=status, detail=detail,
        )
        event_id = new_id("submission")
        with transaction(self.db_path) as conn:
            conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
            manuscript = conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM manuscripts WHERE manuscript_id=?", (manuscript_id,),
            ).fetchone()
            if manuscript is None:
                raise NotFoundError(f"Unknown manuscript: {manuscript_id}")
            if payload.status.value == "PUBLISHED":
                self._set_stage(
                    conn, manuscript_id, "PUBLICATION",
                    expected_revision=manuscript["revision"],
                    reason=payload.detail or f"Publication recorded for {payload.venue}, round {payload.round}",
                    preserve_same_stage=True,
                )
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO submission_events VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                (event_id, manuscript_id, payload.venue, payload.round, payload.status.value,
                 payload.detail, _now()),
            )
            return dict(conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM submission_events WHERE event_id=?", (event_id,),
            ).fetchone())
